title: Durable project instruction contract
description: Objective: establish concise durable project instructions for every provider without copying generated assignments or live Moe state into source control. Deliverables: canonical root AGENTS.md, a minimal root CLAUDE.md bridge, one focused instruction-contract checker/test, and a short ownership note if needed. AGENTS.md owns tool-neutral architecture boundaries, verification commands, explicit-path staging, shared-tree ownership, fail-closed truth, and source-size rails. CLAUDE.md contains only Claude-specific bootstrap/runtime guidance and points to AGENTS.md rather than duplicating it. NOT in scope: task-specific prompts, session transcripts, worker IDs, provider credentials, live .moe state, or generated .codex instructions. Hard dependencies: none. Owned paths: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and a new isolated checker/test path selected by the architect; avoid modifying active package sources.
definitionOfDone: Root AGENTS.md is concise, canonical, tool-neutral, and contains no live task, worker, branch, or session state.
Root CLAUDE.md is a thin Claude bridge to AGENTS.md with no duplicated normative policy and no secrets or generated assignment content.
A deterministic checker fails on missing bridge/canonical markers, oversized files, or forbidden generated/live-state markers without rewriting either file.
Fresh focused verification and repository regression checks exit 0; only explicit owned paths are staged and committed.
taskRails: Keep durable project policy separate from generated provider/session instructions.
Do not edit or delete live .moe, .codex, .claude/settings.local.json, role, skill, task, message, channel, or agent state.
Keep each instruction file short; link to deeper docs rather than accumulating a large prompt.
Use TDD for the checker and stage only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, merge, reset, or stash.
